title: `gauge` / `solid-gauge` / `bullet` / `kpi` all render as a plain number — one missing dial/target renderer, deliberately shared by four spec chart types
body:
Measurement requested by the #4229 ruling (item 4): the QA run of objectstack#7515 recorded, as an untested caveat, that `kpi` / `gauge` / `solid-gauge` / `bullet` all render **value-only, pixel-identical to `metric`** — no dial, no arc, no bullet target band — and asked whether that is the same "no entry in the family map" shape #4229 fixed for `combo`, or four distinct gaps.

**Neither. It is ONE shape, it is deliberate, and it is not #4229's shape.** Filed as an observation so the answer is on the record; no fix is proposed here.

## What was measured

All four names (plus `metric`) are routed to the single-value path by three coordinated places, with **no per-type differentiation anywhere** — nothing branches on `gauge` vs `bullet` vs `kpi`:

| Layer | Symbol | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:313` | `METRIC_TYPES` | `isMetric` — the widget renders as a metric card, the chart path is never reached |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/widgetDispatch.ts:62` | `METRIC_LIKE_TYPES` | `classifyWidgetType` returns `{ family: 'metric' }` |
| `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts:102` | `SINGLE_VALUE_CHART_TYPES` | excluded from `RENDERABLE`; `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:610` draws a number |

So the four types share a single code path by construction, not by four independent oversights.

## Why it is not #4229's shape

#4229 was a **missing** map entry: `combo` fell through `CHART_TYPE_MAP[widgetType] ?? 'bar'` and drew the wrong picture while the renderer *was* able to draw the right one. Here the routing is **present and intentional**, and the renderer genuinely cannot draw the right picture yet:

- `@objectstack/spec`'s own `ChartTypeSchema` groups them under `Performance (single value ...)` and calls gauge / solid-gauge / bullet *"honest single-value variants pending a real dial/target renderer"*.
- objectui#2942 moved them onto this path on purpose: they previously fell into the cartesian component map's `|| BarChart` and rendered a bar **shell** whose series marks all returned null — grid, axes, tooltip and legend with no data marks, indistinguishable from an empty dataset. A number is the honest answer; an empty bar chart was not.

## The actual gap

One missing capability — **no dial / arc / bullet-target renderer exists** — shared by four spec type names. Whoever builds it needs, in one piece of work: a radial gauge (`gauge`, `solid-gauge`), a bullet chart with its comparative target band (`bullet`), and a decision on whether `kpi` stays a `metric` synonym or gains its own treatment. `bullet` additionally has no authored target to draw yet: no target/threshold binding reaches this path today.

Until then the current behaviour is correct-by-design, and the spec comment is the contract. Recording it as a finding rather than a defect: nothing a user hits today is *wrong*, it is unbuilt, and the severity call belongs to triage.

## Source

Measured in the #4229 worktree at `origin/main` `ee66e2ebf`, while `DatasetWidget.tsx` was open. Original caveat: objectstack-ai/objectstack#7515, checklist item `chart-type-matrix`.
